## **Overview**

**GTAPViz** is an R package designed to streamline the processing and
visualization of GTAP-CGE results. While primarily built for **GTAP
simulations, it also supports other `.har` and `.sl4` datasets**.

With intuitive commands and automated adjustments, users can create,
customize, and export high-quality visualizations for journal
publications, economic analysis, and research reports—all with minimal
coding.

## **Key Features**

This package streamlines the creation of figures and tables from `.har`
and `.sl4` results, making academic presentations effortless. Some key
features are:

- **Effortless Multi-Plot Generation** – Automatically adjusts
  dimensions, facets, and layout with minimal input.

- **Smart Plot Adjustments** – Fine-tune visuals easily without manual
  sizing or layout tweaks.

- **Dual Export Plot Formats** – Instantly save high-resolution PNG and
  PDF outputs for slides, papers, and LaTeX.

- **Publication-Ready Pivot Tables** – Generate clean tables alongside
  figures—ideal for academic papers.

- **Streamlined Styling** – Customize colors, fonts, and legends through
  simple, flexible options.

- **Powerful Yet Simple** – Built on `ggplot2`, with intuitive
  `TRUE/FALSE` switches—no advanced coding needed.

- **Self-Contained Help** – Includes a detailed vignette and internal
  help—no need to search online.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## **Installation**

`GTAPViz` package can be installed directly from CRAN (recommended)
using:

``` r
install.packages("GTAPViz")
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`add_mapping_info()`](https://pattawee-pp.com/GTAPViz/reference/add_mapping_info.md)
  : Add Mapping Information to GTAP Data
- [`auto_gtap_data()`](https://pattawee-pp.com/GTAPViz/reference/auto_gtap_data.md)
  : Process GTAP Data Automation with Flexible Output Options
- [`comparison_plot()`](https://pattawee-pp.com/GTAPViz/reference/comparison_plot.md)
  : Create Comparative Bar Charts from HAR and SL4 Data
- [`convert_units()`](https://pattawee-pp.com/GTAPViz/reference/convert_units.md)
  : Convert Units in GTAP Data
- [`create_export_config()`](https://pattawee-pp.com/GTAPViz/reference/create_export_config.md)
  : Create an Export Configuration
- [`create_plot_style()`](https://pattawee-pp.com/GTAPViz/reference/create_plot_style.md)
  : Create a Plot Style Configuration
- [`create_title_format()`](https://pattawee-pp.com/GTAPViz/reference/create_title_format.md)
  : Create a Title Format Configuration
- [`detail_plot()`](https://pattawee-pp.com/GTAPViz/reference/detail_plot.md)
  : Create Comprehensive Bar Charts from HAR and SL4 Data
- [`get_all_config()`](https://pattawee-pp.com/GTAPViz/reference/get_all_config.md)
  : Print Plot and Export Configuration Snippets
- [`get_color_palette()`](https://pattawee-pp.com/GTAPViz/reference/get_color_palette.md)
  : Print and Visualize Themed Color Palettes
- [`pivot_table_with_filter()`](https://pattawee-pp.com/GTAPViz/reference/pivot_table_with_filter.md)
  : Export Data as an Excel Pivot Table
- [`rename_value()`](https://pattawee-pp.com/GTAPViz/reference/rename_value.md)
  : Rename Values in a Column
- [`report_table()`](https://pattawee-pp.com/GTAPViz/reference/report_table.md)
  : Generate a Structured Report Table
- [`sort_plot_data()`](https://pattawee-pp.com/GTAPViz/reference/sort_plot_data.md)
  : Sort GTAP Plot Data
- [`stack_plot()`](https://pattawee-pp.com/GTAPViz/reference/stack_plot.md)
  : Create Stacked Bar Charts for Decomposition Analysis
